# cubepath_vps_plans (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available VPS plans.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location` (String) Optional filter by location name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `plans` (Attributes List) List of available VPS plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth in GB.
- `cluster` (String) The cluster where this plan is available.
- `cpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `location` (String) The location where this plan is available.
- `plan_name` (String) The plan identifier (e.g., 'gp.pro').
- `price_per_hour` (Number) Price per hour in USD.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in MB.
- `storage` (Number) Storage in GB.
